RoughDiamond.sol.content:
/**
 * @title RoughDiamond
 * @dev This contract manages the lifecycle of rough diamonds
 * from initial mining to certification.
 *
 * It ensures that:
 * - Only authorised miners can mint diamonds
 * - Only certifiers can validate conflict-free status
 * - All data is immutably recorded on-chain
 */
contract RoughDiamond {}
